notes.title: Rainy Day Soundtrack and Rainy Day Art Setting Collection are now available
notes.notes:
On February 1st, the Original Soundtrack and Art Setting Collection were released.

The Soundtrack includes all the music from "Rainy Day."
[url=store.steampowered.com] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486640/_/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185352/acd893308e0343fd786dee58657e8daf7333b998.png[/img]

The Art Setting Collection includes the design concepts and artistic settings.
(Currently, the Art Setting Collection is only available in Chinese, but the English version will be updated soon.)
[url=store.steampowered.com] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486640/_/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185352/04c93b9d187549ca355344ebe0120789851cde61.jpg[/img]

If you want to support "Rainy Day," you can purchase the DLC.  
Both DLCs will be discounted during sales, so you can buy them at a lower price during those periods.

Thank you, everyone!

notes.title: Full version update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185352/ba3f326cd321a2a26e2810be1efabe574b9976cc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Level 3 update, welcome to experience the winter street
[*] New gameplay expansion
[*] Complete story process
[*] New NPC dialogue and interaction
[*] New shops and forest scenery
[*] Guide system overhaul
[*] Art asset optimization
[*] Added controller support
[*] Added Steam achievements
[/list]
The duration of the complete game process has been doubled compared to the previous update.
Happy New Year!
